senses.gloss: उप-वङ्ग m. pl. N. of a people, VarBṛS.
उप-वक्तृ॑ ता, m. one who rouses or animates or impels, RV. iv, 9, 5; vi, 71, 5; ix, 95, 5; ŚāṅkhBr.
a kind of priest, ĀśvŚr.; Sāy. on TBr. ii, 2, 1, 1, &c.
1. उप-वाक॑ (for 2. See s.v.), (अस्), m. addressing, praising, RV. i, 164, 8; AV. ix, 9, 8.
2. उप-वा॑क (for 1. see col. 1), अस्, आ, m. f. Indra-grain (cf. इन्द्र-यव), VS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
उप-वाक्य᳙ mfn. to be addressed or praised, RV. x, 69, 12.
उप-वा॑च्य mfn. id., RV. i, 132, 2; iv, 54, 1.
उप-√ वञ्च्
उप-वञ्चन n. the act of crouching or lying close to (see सूपवञ्चन॑).
उप-वञ्चित mfn. deceived, disappointed, R. ii, 52, 19.
उप-वट m. the tree Buchanania Latifolia, L.
उ॑प-वत् mfn. containing the word उप
उ॑प-वती f. (scil. ऋच्) a verse beginning with उप (e.g. RV. ix, 19, 6; 11, 1, &c.), ŚBr. ii; TāṇḍyaBr. xi, 1, 1; Lāṭy.
उप-वत्स्यत् See below.
उप-वत्स्यत् mfn. (fut. p.)
उप-वाद m. censure, blame, KātyŚr.; ṢaḍvBr.
उप-वाद &c. See उप-√ वद्.
उप-वादि॑न् mfn. censuring, blaming, ŚBr. xi; ChUp.

उप-√ वध् P. (aor. उपा॑वधीत्) to strike at or upon, AV. xx, 136, 2;
to strike dead, kill, MBh. xii.
उप-√ वन् (Desid. -विवासति), to propitiate, seek to win or render gracious, RV. vi, 15, 6.
उप-वन n. a small forest or wood, grove, garden, MBh.; Mn.; Megh. &c.
a planted forest, L.
उप-वन—विनोद m. N. of wk.
उप-वनम् ind. near a wood, in the wood, Śiś. vi, 62.
उपाव-√ नम्
उप-वपन n. the act of strewing over, ĀpŚr.
scattering, ĀpŚr.
उप-√ वर्ण् P. -वर्णयति, to tell fully, describe particularly or minutely, communicate, relate, MBh.; BhP.; Hit. &c.
उप-वर्ण m. an inferior caste, L.
उप-वर्णन n. description, minute description, delineation, Yājñ.; Suśr.; Hcat. &c.
glorification, praise, Bālar.
उप-वर्णनीय mfn. to be described.
उप-वर्णित mfn. described minutely, delineated, MBh.; Kathās. &c.
उप-वर्त -वर्तन. See उप-√ वृत्.
उप-वर्त m. a particular high number, L.
उप-वर्ष m. N. of a younger brother of Varṣa (and son of Śaṃkara-svāmin; author of writings on the Mīmāṃsā philosophy), Kathās. &c.
उप-वर्ह See उप-बर्ह.
उप-वल्लिका f. N. of a plant (= अमृतस्रव-लता).
उप-√ वल्ह् (√ वल्ह् connected with √ वृह्?) P. Ā. -वल्हति, -ते, to ask earnestly, importune with a question, VS. xxiii, 51; ŚBr. xi, xii.
उप-वल्ह॑ m. impetuosity, superiority (?), ŚBr. xi, 4, 1, 1.
उप-वत्स्यद्-भक्त n. food taken before fasting, Kauś.; Vait.
उप-वसथ॑ (अस्), m. a fast-day (esp. the day preceding a Soma sacrifice), the period of preparation for the Soma sacrifice, AitBr.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; Kauś.
a place of abiding, village, L.
उपवसथी॑य mfn. belonging to the Upavasatha day or to the preparation for a Soma sacrifice, ŚBr. ix; AitBr.
उपवसथ्य mfn. id.
उप-वसन n. a fast, fasting (see पयोपवसन)
the state of abiding or being near (see पीवो ऽपवसन; both with irr. Sandhi).
उप-वा॑सन n. (√ 4. वस्), a dress, garment, cover, AV. xiv, 2, 49; 65.
(√ 4. वस्) attire, covering, AV.
उपवसनीय mfn. belonging to a fast, Jyot.
उप-वस्त n. a fast, fasting, L.
उप-वस्तव्य mfn. to be celebrated by fasting (as the end of a fortnight), Gobh. i, 5, 5; Jyot.
उप-वस्तृ ता, m. one who fasts, Pat. on Pāṇ. v, 1, 97.
उपवस्त्र्-आदि m. N. of a g. (including besides उपवस्तृ, प्राशितृ), ib.

उप-वास m. (n., L.) a fast, fasting (as a religious act comprising abstinence from all sensual gratification, from perfumes, flowers, unguents, ornaments, betel, music, dancing &c.), Gaut.; ĀśvGṛ.; Mn. ii, 183
xi, 195; 212; Yājñ. iii, 190; MBh. &c.
abstinence from food &c. in general, Suśr.; R.; Pañcat. &c.
kindling a sacred fire
a fire altar, W.
उप-वास—˚व्रतिन् mfn. one who observes a vow of fasting, Naiṣ.
उपवासक mfn. belonging to a fast or fasting, MBh.; Yājñ.
उपवासिन् mfn. one who observes a fast, fasting, MBh.; Dhūrtas.
उपवस्ति g. वेतनादि, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 12
(Kāś. reads उपस्ति.)
उपवस्त्र n. upper clothing, RTL. 415
उपा-√ वह् P. -वहति, to bring or convey near, RV. i, 74, 6; iii, 35, 2.
उप-वह॑ अम्, n. a piece of wood placed on the neck of an ox under the yoke (to raise it to the right level for a yoke-fellow of greater height), ŚBr. i, 4, 4, 7
(v.l. उ॑प-वहस्.)
उप-वाह m. driving, riding, L.
N. of a people, VP.
उ॑प-वहस् for उप-वह, ŚBr., Kāṇva recension.
उप-वाहन n. the act of bringing or carrying near, L.
उप-वाहिन् mfn. flowing or streaming towards, MBh. i, 2367.
उप-वाह्य mfn. to be brought near, R.
(उपवाह्य fr. उप-वाह), serving for driving or riding, serving as a vehicle, VarBṛS.
उप-वाह्य m. an animal for riding, ib.
a king's elephant, any royal vehicle, L.
1. उप-√ वा P. -वाति, to blow upon, ŚBr. xiii, 3, 8, 6.
2. उप-वा॑ f. the act of blowing upon, AV. xii, 1, 51.
1. उ॑प-वात (for 2. See उप-√ वै) mfn. blown upon, ŚBr. iv, 1, 3, 7.
2. उप-वात mfn. (for 1. See उप-√ वा) dried up
dry, ĀśvGṛ.; Kauś.

उप-वाजय Nom. (fr. वाज) P. -वाजयति, to impel, accelerate, ŚBr. v;
to fan, kindle, inflame, TS.; TBr.; KātyŚr.
उप-वाजन n. a fan, KātyŚr.
उपविंश mfn. (pl.) nearly twenty, L.
उप-वि-√ गुल्फ् Caus. (Pot. 3. pl. -गुल्फयेयुस्) to add abundantly, ĀśvŚr. ii, 6, 8, 33.
उप-वि-चार m. environs, neighbourhood, L.
उप-वि॑द् त्, f. (√ 1. विद्), ascertaining, learning, RV. viii, 23, 3 [Sāy.; fr. √ 2. विद्, investigating, finding out, inquiring into, BRD.]
उप-वेदन n. ascertainment, learning, Sāy. on RV. viii, 23, 3.
उप-वेदनीय mfn. to be learnt or found out Comm. on Nyāyad.
उपवेदि ind. near the altar, Kir.
उप-विद्या f. inferior knowledge, profane science.
उप-√ 1. विध् P. (3. pl. -विध॑न्) to honour, worship, RV. i, 149, 1.
उप-विन्दु See उप-बिन्दु.
उप-विन्ध्य m. the land near the Vindhya mountain, L.
उप-विन्ध्याद्रि ind. near the Vindhya mountains, HPariś.
उप-विपाशम् (fr. विपाश्, g. शरद्-आदि, Pāṇ. v, 4, 107) near the (river ?) Vipāś.
उप-वि-मोकम् ind.p. (fr. उपवि-√ मुच्), unharnessing i.e. changing (the oxen), AitBr. iv, 27, 4.

उपा-√ विश् P. -विशति, to enter, enter into any state, MBh.; R.; BhP.;
 (the augmented forms might also be referred to उप-√ विश्.)
उप-वि॑श्य ind.p. having sat down, sitting down &c.
उप-विष्ट mfn. seated, sitting, KātyŚr.; MBh. &c.
come to, arrived, entered (into any state or condition)
ifc. having obtained, R.; Daś. &c.
occupied with, engaged in MBh.; Pañcat.; Bhaṭṭ.
उपविष्टक mfn. ‘firmly settled’ (said of a foetus which remains in the womb beyond the usual time), Car.
उप-वेश॑ अस्, m. the act of sitting down, sitting, resting, TS.; KātyŚr.
the act of applying one's self to or being engaged in MBh.; R.
stool, motion, L.
N. of a Ṛṣi.
उप-वेष॑ अस्, m. a stick (of green wood) used for stirring the sacrificial fire, TS.; TBr.; VS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
उप-वेष॑ See उप-√ विष्.
उप-वेशन n. the act of sitting down, ĀśvŚr.; Kauś.
a seat, Ragh.
the being devoted to or engaged in MBh.; Pañcat.
evacuation or motion of the bowels, Car.
causing to sit down, L.
उ॑प-वेशि m. N. of a Ṛṣi, ŚBr. xiv, 9, 4, 33.
उप-वेशित mfn. caused to sit down, seated
caused to settle.
उप-वेशिन् mfn. ifc. devoting or applying one's self to, MBh.
(उपवेशिन् fr. उप-वेश), one who has a motion of the bowels, Car.
उप-वि-√ श्रम्भ् Caus.
उप-विश्रम्भय्य ind.p. having inspired with confidence, BhP. v, 26, 31
(v.l. अनु-विश्रम्भय्य.)
उप-विष n. factitious poison, a narcotic, any deleterious drug (as opium, datura, &c.)
उप-विषा f. the plant Aconitum Ferox, L.
उप-वि-ष्ठा (उप-वि-√ स्था) Ā. -तिष्ठते, to be or stand here and there, ŚBr. vii, 4, 1, 14.
उप-√ वी P. (2. sg. -वेषि, RV. viii, 11, 4; Impv. -वेतु, RV. v, 11, 4; x, 16, 5) to hasten near, come near, attain, obtain.
उपावी॑ mfn. cherishing, pleasing, VS. vi, 7.
उपावि m. N. of a Ṛṣi, AitBr. i, 25, 15.

उप-वीक्ष् (उप-वि-√ ईक्ष्) Ā. -वीक्षते, to look at or towards, R.;
to regard as fit or proper, Bhpr.

उप-√ वीज् P. -वीजति, to blow upon, fan, MBh. :
Caus. P. -वीजयति, to fan, Śak. 105, 4 Comm. on KātyŚr.
उप-वीजित mfn. blown upon, fanned, MBh. i, 1308; Mṛcch.
उप-वीणय Nom. (fr. वीणा, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 25), to play on a lute before or in the presence of Ragh.; Kād. &c.
उप-वीत &c. See उप-√ व्ये.
उ॑प-वीत mfn. invested with the sacred thread
उ॑प-वीत n. the being invested with the sacred thread
the sacred thread or cord (worn by the first three classes over the left shoulder and under the right arm), TS.; ŚBr.; Mn. ii, 44; 64; iv, 66; Yājñ. i, 29; Hariv.; Ragh. &c. (cf. यज्ञोपवीत.)
उप-वीर m. a kind of demon, PārGṛ. i, 16, 23.

उप-√ वृंह् Caus. -वृंहयति, to make strong or powerful, promote, BhP.; MārkP. &c. ;
 (see also उप-√ बृह्.)
उप-वृंहण n. the act of making strong, invigorating, promoting, R.; BhP.
उप-वृंहित mfn. made strong or powerful, invigorated, supported, promoted
(ifc.) increased or supported or aided by, accompanied by, MBh.; BhP.; Kathās.; Daś. &c.
उप-वृंहिन् mfn. invigorating, supporting, Kathās.
2. उपा-वृ॑त् f. return, AV. vi, 77, 3; VS. xii, 8.
उप-वर्तन n. (fr. the Caus.), the act of bringing near, Sarvad.
a place for exercise
a country (inhabited or not), L.
उपा-वर्तन &c. See col. 3.
उपा-वर्तन n. the act of coming back, return, Ragh. viii, 52; R.; Vātsy.
उप-वृत्त mfn. come near, approached
come back, brought back (from exhaustion &c.), recovered, MBh.
(in geom.) a circle in a particular position relatively to another one.
उपा-वृत mfn. covered, veiled, Hariv.
उपा॑-वृत्त mfn. turned towards, approached or come to, come near, ŚBr.; MBh.; BhP.
returned, come back, MBh.; Śak.; Ragh. &c.
उपा॑-वृत्त m. a horse rolling on the ground, L.
उपा॑-वृत्त m. pl. N. of a people, MBh. vi; VP.
उप-वृत्ति f. motion towards (one's place), Prab.
उपा-वृत्ति f. return, TāṇḍyaBr.
उप-√ वे P. to bring into close contact with, enclose, enfold, wrap.

उपावे (उप-अव-√ इ) P. उपा॑वैति, to go or come down, descend, AV. ix, 6, 53; TBr. ii;
to join (in calling), assent, consent, ŚBr.
उप-वाय ind. p, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 41, Kāś.
उप-वेणा f. N. of a river, MBh.
उप-वेणु m. (prob.) common reed, Hcat.

उप-वेद m. ‘secondary knowledge’, N. of a class of writings subordinate or appended to the four Vedas (viz. the आयुर्-वेद, or science of medicine, to the Ṛg-veda; the धनुर्वेद or science of archery, to the Yajur-veda; the गान्धर्व-वेद or science of music, to the Sāmaveda; and the शस्त्र-शास्त्र or science of arms, to the Atharva-veda; this is according to the Caraṇavyūha, but, Suśr. and the Bhpr. make the Āyur-veda belong to the Atharva-veda; according to others, the स्थापत्य-वेद or science of architecture, and शिल्प-शास्त्र or knowledge of arts, are reckoned as the fourth Upa-veda).
उप-√ वेष्ट् Caus.
उप-वेष्टन n. the act of wrapping up, swathing.
उप-वेष्टित mfn. wrapped in, surrounded, Mṛcch.; Kathās.
उपवेष्टितिन् mfn. one who has wrapped himself round the loins in a cloth, Āp.
उप-√ वै P. -वायति, to dry up, shrink in drying, TāṇḍyaBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; Kāṭh.
उपवैणव n. (fr. उप-वेणु?) the three periods of the day (viz. morning, midday, and evening), L.
उप-√ व्यध् P. (2. sg. -विध्यसि) to throw at or on, hit, MBh. vii, 6534 (ed. Calc.)
उप-व्याख्यान n. (√ ख्या), a supplementary explanation, ChUp.; MuṇḍUp.
उप-व्याघ्र m. the small hunting leopard, L.
उप-व्युष॑म् ind. about dawn, TBr.; TāṇḍyaBr.
उप-व्युषसम् ind. id., KātyŚr.; Āp.; Car.
उप-√ व्ये Ā. -व्ययते, to put on or invest one's self with the sacred thread, TS. ii, 5, 11, 1.
उपवीतक n. the sacred thread, Kathās.; BhP.
उपवीति॑न् mfn. wearing the sacred cord in the usual manner (over the left shoulder and under the right arm), VS. xvi, 17; KātyŚr.; ĀśvŚr.; Mn. ii, 63 (cf. यज्ञोपवीतिन्.)
उप-वी॑य ind.p. having put on the sacred thread, TBr. i, 6, 8, 2; Kāṭh.; BhP.
उप-√ व्रज् P.
उपा-√ व्रज् P. -व्रजति, to betake one's self to, BhP.
उप-व्र॑ज्य ind.p. having gone towards, coming near, approaching, TBr. iii, 10, 11, 3; BhP.
going behind, following, R. v.
उप-व्रजम् ind. near a cattle pen, BhP.
उप-व्रत n. a minor vow or observance, Baudh.
उप-व्रतय Nom. (fr. व्रत) Ā. (Pot. 3. pl. -व्रतयेरन्) to eat (anything) together with the food prescribed for a Vrata or fast, ĀśvŚr. ii, 6, 8, 39.
उप-व्लय See उप-ब्लय.
उपाव् (उप-√ अव्) P. -अवति, to cherish, behave friendly towards, encourage by approval, approve, consent, RV.; AV. i, 16, 2; ŚBr. iii.
उपाव-√ धा
उपा॑व-हित mfn. placed or put down close by, TBr. ii, 7, 18, 4.
उपाव-नत mfn. bent in ĀpŚr.

उपाव-√ रम् Ā. to sport, take one's pleasure;
to prance about (as a horse), TāṇḍyaBr. vi.

उपाव-√ रुह् P. -रोहति, to descend upon, come out towards, VS. vi, 26; TS. vii; TBr.; ŚBr.; TāṇḍyaBr.; ŚāṅkhGṛ. :
Caus. -रोहयति, to cause (the fire) to come out (of the two Araṇis), kindle through friction, ŚāṅkhŚr.; Kauś.
उपाव-रोहण n. the act of causing (fire) to come out (of the two Araṇis), kindling through friction, ŚāṅkhGṛ. v, 1, 7.
उपाव-√ श्रि Ā. -श्रयते, to betake one's self to, ŚBr. iv, 6, 9, 5.
उ॑पा-वसु mfn. bringing near or procuring riches, RV. v, 56, 6; ix, 84, 3; 86, 33.
उपाव-सृष्ट mfn. admitted (as a calf to its mother)
उपाव-सृष्ट n. the milk of a cow at the time when its calf is admitted (cf. उप-सृष्ट), AitBr. v, 26, 6.
उपाव-√ सृप् P. -सर्पति, to creep towards, approach creeping, ŚBr.
उपाव-√ सो P. -स्यति, to settle near at (acc.), TS. ii.
उपावसायि॑न् mfn. attaching one's self to
submissive, compliant, ŚBr.
उपा॑वसित mfn. settled or abiding near by, ŚBr. iii.
उपाव-√ हृ P. -हरति, to fetch or bring or take down, cause to let down (e.g. the arms), VS. viii, 56; TBr.; ŚBr.; AitBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.
उपाव-हरण n. the act of taking or bringing down, KātyŚr. ix.
उपा-√ वृ
उपा-वर्तितृ॑ mfn. one who will turn towards (periphrastic fut.), TBr. i, 6, 7, 3.
उपा-वृत्य ind.p. having turned towards, going near
applying one's self to &c.
उपावेक्ष् (उप-अव-√ ईक्ष्) Ā. -ईक्षते, to look down upon, ŚBr.
उपा-व्याध॑ अस्, m. (√ व्यध्), a vulnerable or unprotected spot, TS. vii, 2, 5, 4.
